About

I ship systems, not just screens.

I'm a final-year Diploma in ICT Application Development student at Sol Plaatje University in Kimberley, South Africa, graduating in 2027 Alongside my studies, I work as a FASSET Academic Support Tutor mentoring first-year ICT students, and served as an elected House Committee member at Moroka Residence.

What I care about most is owning the full build - designing a normalised database, writing the API, and getting the interface to feel right, rather than any single layer. That's shown up across four shipped projects: a campus ride-hailing app with biometric face verification and live GPS tracking, a luxury car rental platform, a multi-role restaurant management system, and a freelance portfolio site built for a fashion designer client.

01

CampusConnect

Capstone project - full-stack ride-sharing platform

A ride-sharing app built for campus commuters, with live route mapping, driver verification, SOS alerts, and JWT-based authentication. Backend built on Spring Boot with a MySQL schema covering rides, drivers, payments and face verification; frontend built with React Native and Expo, using OpenStreetMap and OSRM for live, road-following routes.

  • React Native
  • Spring Boot
  • MySQL
  • JWT
  • OSRM / OpenStreetMap

Taste Heaven

Cross-platform restaurant management system

A restaurant management system covering four distinct user roles - customer, waiter, chef and manager - built across Android and desktop. Combines a Java Swing management console with an Android front end, backed by Firebase and MySQL for order and staff data.

Who I am

The short version, beyond the tech stack.

Systems thinker

I'd rather own a project end to end than one layer of it - schema first, then the API, then the interface. It's why every project I ship has a database diagram behind it.

Patient mentor

As a FASSET Academic Support Tutor I break down programming and systems concepts for first-year students, adjusting my explanation to how each person actually learns.

Community-minded

Elected to the Moroka Residence House Committee - resolving conflicts, coordinating programmes, and representing students' interests day to day.

Calm under pressure

Competed at the GKHack25 hackathon with Team MzansiMavericks, and I'm an active member of Circuit Breakers, SPU's cross-course problem-solving club.

Capstone · Final-Year Project

CampusConnect

  • React Native / Expo
  • Spring Boot
  • MySQL 8.0
  • JWT
  • WebSockets
  • OSRM / OpenStreetMap

A safety-first, student-exclusive ride-hailing platform connecting verified university students with fellow student drivers on a fuel-share cost model - replacing informal, unverified lift arrangements with a monitored, role-based system. Biometric face verification runs before every trip, live GPS tracking streams over WebSockets, and an SOS system alerts campus security within 20 seconds with live coordinates and encrypted audio.

8 tablesnormalised MySQL schema
4 rolesRider / Driver / Admin / Security
<20sSOS alert response
85%min. face-match confidence
  • Biometric face verification before every trip
  • Live GPS tracking via WebSockets
  • SOS alerts with encrypted audio recording
  • 3-tier architecture: Android/Expo → Spring Boot → MySQL
  • Full ERD, UML diagrams, PERT/Gantt planning
  • POPIA-compliant data handling

A no-login municipal fault-reporting system designed for eThekwini residents with low digital literacy, limited data budgets, and entry-level Android devices - grounded in real interviews with two residents and redesigned around trust rather than just interface. Report a pothole, water leak, or power outage in under 90 seconds, no account required, with a trackable reference number and status updates by SMS.
